FL-034.label: The curators deconflict, dedupe and remove slop, triggered by every n memory writes rather than by the clock, and run at the Palace's own location.
FL-034.walk: Add 25 memories to a palace holding near-duplicates; a curator pass runs on its own (every 25 admitted writes or 3 gate removals), finds the pair by near-identical relevance scores on the standard probe set as well as by embedding, and proposes one lossless combined memory; Palace State shows the pass and the palace's growth curve bending.
FL-034.observed: Three original browser cases automatically complete at 25 admitted writes, nominate the intended merge, record the actual model and refresh after approval. Three original API corpora prove identical four-probe pair evidence on repeated unchanged passes.

FL-035.label: Constitution: A scripted pre-pass that writes a versioned Palace Health Report the curator must read before acting (v2.8–2.9 curator law).
FL-035.walk: Run a curator pass; its record shows the Palace Health Report it read first.
FL-035.observed: The versioned health report is read for each pass; release-original-9 through 11 prove identical probes and nominations, persisted keeps, a 25-pair cap and source-revision invalidation. Charged diagnostic corner only.

FL-036.label: The curators have the right tools and standard procedures for their work, and act as surgeons: minimally invasive, targeting the root problem and letting the system sort out the symptoms.
FL-036.walk: Run a curator pass on a Palace with one duplicate pair; the pass touches only that pair and nothing else.
FL-036.observed: Three original browser corpora each queue only the intended pair; inspected final pool and ferry proposals retain their qualifiers. Three fee corpora produce contradict cards. Prior failed attempts remain recorded.

FL-037.label: Constitution: Typed consolidation decisions: merge, new, contradict, supersede (curator spec).
FL-037.walk: Open a curator merge card: it shows the lossless combined memory beside its sources; approve, amend the text, or give feedback (which is recorded as a tuning signal); a typed merge / new / contradict / supersede verdict is visible on the card (owner, 2026-09-30).
FL-037.observed: Merge/contradiction corner: three final merge cards preserve sources, feedback records with an icon, owner amendment is saved and both sources retire. Three plain-fee corpora show contradict. Other verdict classes are not claimed.
